name: ICEF Performing Arts Presents Disney's "DESCENDENTS THE MUSICAL"
description: ICEF Performing Arts proudly presents Disneys Descendants: The Musical at the historic Miracle Theater in Inglewood! Welcome to Auradon, where the children of Disneys most notorious villains Maleficent, the Evil Queen, Jafar and Cruella de Vil, are given an unexpected opportunity to leave the Isle of the Lost and attend school alongside the children of Disneys greatest heroes. Filled with high-energy music, dance, comedy and familiar characters, Descendants asks a surprisingly meaningful question: Are young people destined to inherit the choices and expectations of the generations before them, or can they choose who they want to become? At its heart, Descendants reminds us that where a young person comes from does not determine where they can go. That idea lives at the center of ICEF Performing Arts. Through theatre, music, dance and technical production, scholars are challenged to discover their voices, develop their talents, build community and imagine possibilities for themselves.
